mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 1% signals accommodative monetary policy, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in UNRATE above 6% in a month signals weakening labor market strength, prompting investors to anticipate economic slowdown risks and drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses above 6%, or the effect reverses in subsequent months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in both GDPC1 (demand) and RSAFS (demand) proxies indicate robust economic growth, leading to higher equity valuations and positive 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: The 5-day returns are not positively correlated with the joint rise in GDPC1 and RSAFS proxies (Pearson correlation < 0.3 over 5-year window).

mechanism_narrative: An upward crossing of the INDPRO supply index above 105 suggests expanded production capacity, reducing inflation expectations and fostering positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO above 105 does not consistently precede positive 60-day returns (t-test p > 0.05 in 3-year window).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising), higher interest rates reduce discount rates on equities, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In a tightening cycle, FEDFUNDS rising does not consistently lead to negative returns (p > 0.05 in 2-year walk-forward).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in PAYEMS (labor) and GDPC1 (demand) proxies signal strong labor demand and economic expansion, driving positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: Concurrent rises in PAYEMS and GDPC1 do not predict positive 60-day returns (IC < 0.05 over 3-year period).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in INDPRO alongside persistently low FEDFUNDS (below 1%) signals accommodative policy and lower inflation expectations, driving positive 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO increases without FEDFUNDS staying below 1% do not correlate with positive 5-day returns (Pearson < 0.3).

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime (CPIAUCSL above 215 and FEDFUNDS below 1%), lower inflation and accommodative monetary policy enhance equity valuations, resulting in positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: In post-shock regimes, the combination of CPIAUCSL >215 and FEDFUNDS <1% does not consistently yield positive returns (IC < 0.03 over 3 years).
